name: Black Diamond Therapeutics, Inc. Common Stock
description: Black Diamond Therapeutics Inc is a clinical-stage oncology company developing MasterKey therapies that target families of oncogenic mutations in patients with cancer. The foundation of companies has been built upon a deep understanding of cancer genetics, onco-protein structure and function, and medicinal chemistry. Its clinical-stage program, silevertinib (formerly BDTX-1535), a brain-penetrant, fourth-generation epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR) MasterKey inhibitor, is currently being studied in a Phase 2 clinical trial in patients with epidermal growth factor receptor mutant (EGFRm) non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC). The Company manages its operations as a single operating segment and single reportable segment.
